title: The Moral Check: Strategic AI Governance for the Pacing Problem
abstract: arXiv:2609.22869v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Technology cannot steer itself. Strategy provides that steering, establishing the rule that purpose and judgment must precede compute capital. As the frontier artificial intelligence (AI) ecosystem accelerates exponentially, the pacing problem induces severe cognitive tunneling in engineering teams, prioritizing scalar throughput over human judgment. A calibrated pacing rate is imperative to check unchecked scaling, guarantee safety, and build models in whose alignment society can place warranted confidence. Traditional oversight fails through retrospective checklists, a pathology of performative governance exhibiting high procedural maturity but alarming scientific immaturity. We deliver a dual contribution: a PRISMA 2020 review synthesizing 130 empirical studies (MMAT-appraised across 18 benchmarks; total corpus N = 130 empirical studies across 178 reference foundations), and the Strategic AI Governance Ex-Ante Framework (SAGE-X). Ou

translated_title: 道德制衡：应对步调问题的战略性AI治理
translated_abstract: 技术无法自我引导，战略提供了这种引导，确立了目的和判断必须先于算力资本的规则。随着前沿人工智能（AI）生态系统呈指数级加速发展，步调问题在工程团队中引发严重的认知隧道效应，使标量吞吐量被置于人类判断之上。一个经过校准的步调速率对于遏制无节制的扩张、保障安全以及构建社会能够合理信任其对齐性的模型至关重要。传统监督通过回顾性清单而失效，这是一种表演性治理的病理现象，表现出高度的程序成熟度却存在令人担忧的科学不成熟性。我们提供了双重贡献：一项综合了130项实证研究的PRISMA 2020系统综述（通过MMAT在18个基准上进行评估；总语料库N = 130项实证研究，涵盖178个参考文献基础），以及战略性AI治理事前框架。
tldr: 该论文提出SAGE-X战略性AI治理事前框架，主张通过校准的步调速率和事前治理机制来应对AI加速发展引发的步调问题，以取代失效的回顾性清单式表演性监督。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the SAGE-X Strategic AI Governance Ex-Ante Framework, advocating calibrated pacing rates and ex-ante governance mechanisms to address the pacing problem caused by accelerating AI, replacing failed retrospective checklist-based performative oversight.
